digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and Gerrit DET code-review criterion
propositions: Explicit 'review-plan <bug>' on tickets with persisted non-test file_impact must escalate from the light advisory tier to the full blocking rubric, applying the escalation deterministically at both the precheck and route_criteria seams and the batch-runner fan-in.

Gerrit DET criterion must block bug-fix commits with non-test diff >150 lines and plan_review_status verdict not in {certified, stale-code, stale-head} by reading the attestation cross-host via opcert verification with trusted-environment keyrings, never via own-env verify_opcert_record.

The attestation verdict predicate must accept {certified, stale-code, stale-head}, FLAG the remaining compute_validity plan-review-reachable literals and {mismatch, key_not_valid_at_era, unknown_kind, unknown_scheme, invalid}, and fail OPEN (advisory only, never block) on {unavailable, error, unknown future verdicts}.

The non-test line classification rule must consistently exclude tests/** and conftest.py across both the B1 escalation logic and the B2 Gerrit criterion using a single shared BUGFIX_SIZE_THRESHOLD=150 constant.

The backtest over 113 historical bug-fix commits must flag exactly the 13 hand-adjudicated substantive fixes and zero mechanical false positives by applying the non-test classification and 150-line threshold.
The rebar-debug skill Phase-1-exit hook must invoke review-plan for non-trivial fixes, coordinated with child ticket 78f1's writeback anchors.
